svg.title: Whitehall Mystery: location difficulty associations
svg.desc: Blue easy, green medium, red hard. Derived from the published randomizer's output probabilities across all 444360 four-location combinations. These are not official per-location ratings.

g.text: Derived: color = the mode most likely to select this location, including selection adjustments.
The site rates four-location sets. Unhighlighted locations are not discovery candidates.
Source: whitehallmystery.com/main.js?v=7 · All 444,360 sets · Difficulty is for Jack
